Official YouTube Channel of LUNEX – Higher education institution specialised in Health, Sports and Management, located in Differdange (Luxembourg). 
Educational and scientific focus on sports, management and health. Real international atmosphere with students, teachers and staff from all over the world. Get an insight. 

Find out more: https://www.lunex.lu
